## berth repo rm

unregister a repo (its folder goes to quarantine; --delete removes it)

### Synopsis

unregister a repo (its folder goes to quarantine; --delete removes it)

Docs: https://ar4mirez.github.io/berth/reference/commands/berth_repo_rm/

```
berth repo rm <org> <dir> [--delete] [flags]
```

### Examples

```
  berth repo rm acme widgets
  berth repo rm acme widgets --delete
```
